description: This file defines the interface for TCP operations within the network stack, including connection management, listening, accepting, and packet processing functions.

methods.name: net_tcp_get
methods.description: Allocates a TCP connection and links it with the network context.

methods.name: net_tcp_put
methods.description: Closes and deletes the TCP connection associated with the network context.

methods.name: net_tcp_listen
methods.description: Sets the network context to listen for incoming TCP connections.

methods.name: net_tcp_accept
methods.description: Registers a callback for accepting incoming TCP connections.

methods.name: net_tcp_input
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the TCP header from a network packet.

methods.name: net_tcp_update_recv_wnd
methods.description: Updates the receive window size for a TCP connection.

methods.name: net_tcp_finalize
methods.description: Finalizes TCP packet processing, optionally forcing checksum.

methods.name: tcp_input
methods.description: Handles an incoming TCP packet for testing purposes.
